headline: HuyenBao v11.22 — notification visibility fix + nav visual hierarchy + tab rename + life-flow reorder
summary: UX pass per detailed player feedback. (1) Notification visibility fix — AI oracle popup rate bumped 6%→9%/day, ambient mini-event rate bumped 3%→6%/day, toast moved from bottom-center to top-center with accent border + bigger font + slide-in-from-top animation + higher z-index. Previously the toast was easy to miss at the bottom; now it appears prominently at the top. (2) Nav visual hierarchy — Level 1 (group) active state now uses gold accent background + dark text (MOST prominent), Level 2 (sub-tab) active uses subtle muted bg + gold border + gold text (less prominent). Previously both used similar pill backgrounds causing confusion. Added divider line between the two rows. Level 1 tabs are now bigger + bolder; Level 2 tabs smaller + muted. (3) Tab rename per UX feedback — 'Danh mục'→'Tài sản' (Assets), 'Quan hệ'→'Xã hội' (Social), 'Thế giới'→'Đế chế' (Empire), 'Tri thức'→'Học vấn' (Education) in VI; EN: 'Portfolio'→'Assets', 'Sphere'→'Social', 'World'→'Empire', 'Capital'→'Education'. ZH updated too. (4) Life-flow reorder — groups reordered from Character→Education→Business→Assets→Social→World to Character→Education→Assets→Business→Social→Empire. Player accumulates cash (Assets) before opening businesses, and Empire (meta-game/end-game) sits last. 4 Huyen-Hoc-AI features unchanged.
features: AI oracle popup rate bumped 6%→9% per eligible game-day (~1 popup per 5.5 min of active play)
Ambient mini-event rate bumped 3%→6% per game-day (~1 toast per 8 min) + threshold lowered from day>60 to day>30
Toast moved from bottom-center to top-center with accent border + bigger font (1.08rem) + slide-in-from-top animation + z-index 200 (was 80)
Nav visual hierarchy: Level 1 active = gold accent bg + dark text + box-shadow (MOST prominent); Level 2 active = muted bg + gold border + gold text (less prominent)
Divider line added between Level 1 and Level 2 nav rows
Level 1 tabs: bigger (font-size .95rem) + bolder (font-weight 800); Level 2 tabs: smaller (.82rem) + muted (font-weight 550)
Tab rename VI: 'Danh mục'→'Tài sản', 'Quan hệ'→'Xã hội', 'Thế giới'→'Đế chế', 'Tri thức'→'Học vấn'
Tab rename ZH: '组合'→'资产', '圈子'→'社交', '世界'→'帝国', '资本'→'学业'

Life-flow reorder: Character→Education→Assets→Business→Social→Empire (was Character→Education→Business→Assets→Social→World). Player accumulates cash before opening businesses; Empire (meta-game) sits last
Version bumped to v11.22 at FRONT of app name (v11.22 HuyenBao)
